note: Samoa: any non-citizen working in Samoa must hold a Foreign Employment Employee Permit (FEEP), applied for by the employer before work begins, tied to the employer and role, valid for up to three years, issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour under Part IX of the Consolidated Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 (amended 2023) after a labour market test; the employee also needs a residence permit. No performers' exemption and no days are named. Read on the Ministry's own page.

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa), Employment services: Foreign Employment Employee Permit (FEEP)
sources.said: Any non-citizen wishing to work in Samoa must hold a valid Foreign Employment Employee Permit (FEEP) . Employers must apply for the permit before the employee commences work. ... Valid for up to 3 years , subject to conditions deemed appropriate by the CEO.
